title: Banff and Jasper Two Day Lakes and Hot Springs Tour
includes: Travel in a comfortable air-conditioned Van or Suv
Explore with a knowledgeable local guide.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning landscapes of Banff National Park over two immersive days. From the picturesque Banff Town to the breathtaking turquoise waters of Lake Louise, this tour brings you to iconic sites perfect for nature enthusiasts. Experience the thrill of the Banff Gondola and unwind at the Upper Hot Springs, all while soaking in the majestic scenery. Day two takes you along the breathtaking Icefields Parkway, with stops at Crowfoot Glacier and the awe-inspiring Glacier Skywalk, providing a mix of adventure and relaxation. This tour is ideal for first-time visitors and those seeking a memorable Canadian wilderness experience.

- Explore charming Banff Town and iconic lakes like Lake Louise and Bow Lake
- Enjoy scenic views from the Banff Gondola and Glacier Skywalk
- Relax at the Upper Hot Springs after a day of adventure
- Two full days of exploration with expert insights into Banff's natural beauty
